description.narrative:
Increased access to non-life insurance for individuals and MSMEs: The Project is expected to increase MAAGAPs reach by diversifying its distribution channels and increasing digitalization, particularly through a portal and system for its distribution partners which will improve the operational efficiency of these intermediaries. This will help to increase access to non-life insurance services for individuals and MSMEs in the Philippines.
Competitiveness: At the market level, IFC anticipates that the Project will increase competitive pressures within the non-life insurance sector in the Philippines by driving innovation and the replication of MAAGAPs approach of using lending, pawnshops and money remittance centers with country-wide distribution networks as a non-traditional channel which will extend the reach of non-life insurance products to underserved MSMEs and individuals.

International Finance Corporation (IFC) is considering an equity investment of up to US$10 million for an up to 17% effective stake in MAA General Assurance Philippines Inc (MAAGAP or the Company) together with lead investor Triple P Advisory Pte Limited (Triple P, Lead Investor) and other development financial institutions (DFIs). MAAGAP is a non-life insurance company in the Philippines with 2% market share based on gross written premiums (GWP).
